verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a hosted orchestration SaaS that processes customer workflow data, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer data is used to train AI models. Self-hosting and plan-level data retention limits are related controls, not a documented no-training guarantee or opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
